title: Undo the subset accumulation
hook: An accumulated subset table has a local inverse.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Invert a subset zeta transform with dimensionwise subtraction.

misconception: Recovering original subset weights requires solving a dense linear system.
objective: Invert a subset zeta transform with dimensionwise subtraction.

claims.text: Subtraction undoes each dimension’s earlier accumulation. The cleared-bit entry does not depend on the set-bit entry in that same dimension, so the local inverse removes exactly the contribution that was introduced, recovering the original subset weights.
